title: Servo axis tuning
line: A cascaded position loop's response to a 10 mm step.
description: A linear axis on a servo motor: PI velocity loop inside a P position loop, then a 10 mm step. Inertia and damping referred to the motor; gains from a first tuning pass.
thumbnailAlt: Position of a servo axis after a 10 mm step, with overshoot, rendered by RunMat
